text:
Great morning……hold my coffee ☕️ 

Let me explain these “theories”
Yes, I did in fact join 60 lawmakers (Black and white) in asking federal agencies to launch thorough, transparent, and independent investigations into hanging deaths of Black individuals reported across the country. Yes, we also requested independent autopsies, evidence reviews, and a national tracking system for these deaths.

Yes, In 2022, I voted to pass the Emmitt Till Anti Lynching Act. The bill finally passed, and was signed into law after Congress failed to pass federal anti-lynching legislation more than 200 times over a span of 122 years.

Yes, Then and now, I am unapologetic about having a problem with Black people hanging from trees- and believe THAT warrants an independent investigation. I taught students to learn from the past, live in the present and plan for the future…..you would be wise to learn that lesson as well 📚 

Now run tell that!

Stop with the distractions.
See you in 43 days 🗳️

https://t.co/N81LDjiJ8q
